description: This file defines a C++ wrapper for D-Bus client interactions, including classes, types, and functions for making D-Bus calls, handling signals, and managing variants and tuples. It provides abstractions for D-Bus types, directions, object descriptors, and parameter templates, facilitating D-Bus communication in C++ projects.

classes.name: GDBusCall
classes.description: Base class for D-Bus method call definitions, supporting synchronous calls and parameter binding.

classes.name: GDBusSignal
classes.description: Base class for D-Bus signal handling, allowing registration of callbacks for signals.

classes.name: GDBusVariant
classes.description: Wrapper for D-Bus variant data, providing methods to extract typed values and print contents.

classes.name: GDBusTuple
classes.description: Helper class for unmarshalling and representing D-Bus tuples with nested typed fields.

classes.name: GDBusObjectDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for D-Bus objects, including name, path, and interface.

methods.name: callSync
methods.description: Performs the D-Bus call, handling serialization and deserialization of parameters.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for a specific D-Bus signal.

methods.name: waitAndProcessSignals
methods.description: Initializes and runs the event loop to process incoming D-Bus signals.

methods.name: stopProcessingSignals
methods.description: De-initializes internal GLib objects used for signal processing.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns values from a vector of GDBusVariants to the tuple's fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed string representation of the tuple contents.
